snippet.title: Fallen Fates - Kickstarter Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Fallen Fates Kickstarter Date was announced at the MIX Fall Game Showcase 2025 with a brand new trailer.
Prepare for vast areas to explore, epic fights, beautiful cinematics and memorable characters!

Kickstarter campaign launch September 18th - https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/hibernian-workshop/fallen-fates 

Wishlist on Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3276270/Fallen_Fates/

Join the community -  https://discord.com/invite/hibernian-workshop
